input.quote: 19.5 Except for the express warranties in this Agreement, neither Party makes an implied warranty to the maximum extent lawful. No disclaimer limits an express warranty, service level, indemnity, confidentiality duty, data-protection duty, or remedy expressly provided here.
input.rationale: There is no indemnification clause anywhere in the Agreement: the outline jumps from Section 19 (Warranties) to Section 21 (Limitation of Liability), and searches for "indemnify", "hold harmless", "defend" and infringement claim language return only incidental references that presuppose an indemnity that does not exist (Section 9.3 cross-refers to "Section 20.5" remedies, 19.4/19.5 refer to "indemnified claims" and "indemnity", 21.3 makes "indemnification obligations" Excluded Claims, and 30.5 preserves "indemnified party" rights). That is walk-away territory (no Vendor IP indemnity at all), so we insert a new Section 20 at the preferred level: Vendor defence and indemnity of Customer and its Affiliates for third-party IP infringement, breach of Applicable Law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, with notice/control/cooperation procedure and a Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law. We target preferred rather than fallback because fallback's 3× annual-fee super-cap would be worse for us than the existing uncapped treatment of indemnification obligations under Section 21.3. Note the pre-existing cross-reference in Section 9.3 to "Section 20.5" remedies remains unmatched; we can align numbering or add procure/modify/replace/refund remedies if Vendor prefers.

proposal.summary: Insert missing Section 20 Vendor indemnity, claim procedure, and narrow Customer indemnity
proposal.comment: [Playbook] The Agreement has no indemnity section at all (Section 9.3 already assumes one), so we have added our preferred Vendor defence and indemnity for IP infringement, breach of law, Vendor-caused data breach and gross negligence or wilful misconduct, a standard notice/control/cooperation procedure, and a Customer indemnity limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.

ops.text: INDEMNIFICATION. Vendor shall defend, indemnify and hold harmless Customer and its Affiliates from and against any third-party claim, and all resulting damages, costs and expenses (including reasonable attorneys' fees), to the extent arising out of (a) an allegation that the Services or Deliverables infringe or misappropriate any intellectual property right; (b) Vendor's breach of Applicable Law; (c) any unauthorized access to or disclosure of Customer Data caused by Vendor; or (d) Vendor's gross negligence or wilful misconduct. Customer shall give Vendor written notice of the claim, Vendor shall control its defence and settlement, and Customer shall provide reasonable cooperation. Customer shall indemnify Vendor only against third-party claims arising out of content Customer provides to the Services and Customer's breach of Applicable Law.

mappings.element: Vendor has an express duty to defend Customer and its affiliates.
Vendor indemnifies Customer and its affiliates against third-party claims.
Vendor indemnity covers claims that Services or Deliverables infringe intellectual property rights.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's breach of applicable law.
Vendor indemnity covers a data breach caused by Vendor.
Vendor indemnity covers Vendor's gross negligence and wilful misconduct.
The indemnification procedure requires notice of a claim.
The indemnification procedure allocates control of the defence.
The indemnification procedure requires reasonable cooperation.
Customer indemnity is limited to Customer-provided content and Customer's breach of law.
